defects_fixed: 3009/17 Faction -> Side (Friendly/Enemy is a side, not a named faction)
3072/24 'Play in-game BGM.' -> 'Listen to the game's BGM.' (BGM Test, not playback during play)
kept_as_intentional: 3040/15 and 3086/5 keep Change:, matching the released Free Mission footer of the same menu family; option screens keep Set:
3044/9-10 use OK: and ASCII spaces because the six-item guide must fit 620 units, as in the deployment guide
Option screens use 'Reset Defaults' (139 units): the released 'Restore Defaults' is 159-161 and the button holds about 156
uncertainties: Old City vs Old Town for the Versus stage; no glossary entry
Scub Coral, Desert, Above D.O.M.E. have no glossary entry; no conflicting use in the corpus
Combo Attack (renkei) and Combination Attack are probably one mechanic under two source names; both follow released text
'Switch the lock-on reticle' is literal; in play it may cycle the lock-on target
Secret Goal assumes one secret condition per mission
1P/2P Controller in control: the modal names which pad is operating it
Adjacent icon pairs in the Model Viewer guide are not checked on screen
post_review_compression: 3091/2, 3070/45, 3009/41 and 3021/25 were shortened after review so that no text allocation has to grow (hangar memory, see HANGAR_MEMORY_016.md); meaning unchanged: total record of units used so far / demo not played
